https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.title: Ukraine-Krieg | Evakuierung von Oleschky abgeschlossen
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.author: Daniel Säwert
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.text:
- Politik
- Ukraine-Krieg
Evakuierung von Oleschky abgeschlossen
Humanitäre Aktion könnte Vorbild für weitere Rettungsmissionen sein, so die Hoffnung. Wenn sich beide Kriegsparteien genügend vertrauen
Die Evakuierungsmission in Oleschky ist abgeschlossen. Fotos und Videos ukrainischer Stellen vom Sonnabend zeigen, wie Bewohner der seit über vier Jahren umkämpften Frontstadt im Gebiet Cherson die belarussisch-ukrainische Grenze im Gebiet Tschernihiw überqueren. Kurz zuvor hatten bereits die Haustiere der Evakuierten von Kiew kontrolliertes Gebiet erreicht.
Für die Evakuierten, größtenteils ältere Menschen, endet damit eine lange Reise vorerst. Am Vortag wurden sie mit Bussen aus dem gegenüber Cherson gelegenen Oleschky mit Bussen in den russischen Schwarzmeerort Anapa gebracht, von wo sie nach Gomel im südlichen Belarus, unweit der ukrainischen Grenze, geflogen wurden.
Die Evakuierung sei problemlos verlaufen, schrieb der ukrainische Menschenrechtsbeauftragte Dmytro Lubinez auf Telegram. An der russischen Grenze habe es weder Filtrationen gegeben, noch seien die Telefone durchsucht worden. Den Menschen werde jede notwendige Hilfe gewährt, schrieb Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj, der die Behörden zu »effizienter Arbeit« aufrief, um den Evakuierten bei der Eingewöhnung zu helfen.
Zahl der Evakuierten unbekannt
Offizielle Zahlen, wie viele Menschen aus Oleschky evakuiert wurden, gibt es bislang nicht. Nach Angaben des Journalisten Alex Salvi, der für die rechtskonservative US-Nachrichtenseite »Newsmax« vor Ort war, sollen elf Busse Richtung Ukraine und vier Busse Richtung Russland aufgebrochen sein. Bei voller Besetzung der Busse hätten sich demnach 550 Menschen für eine Evakuierung in von Kiew kontrolliertes Gebiet der Ukraine entschieden und 250 für Russland.
Russischen Medienberichten zufolge soll es weitere Evakuierungsfahrten nach Russland und auf die Krim gegeben haben, die nicht Teil der gemeinsamen russisch-ukrainischen Aktion waren.
Laut Beobachtern sollen sich zum Zeitpunkt des Waffenstillstands noch 1500 bis 2000 Zivilisten in Oleschky aufgehalten haben. Demnach hätte sich die Hälfte der verbliebenen Einwohner oder sogar mehr dazu entschieden, in der Stadt und damit unter russischer Kontrolle zu bleiben, merkt der Telegram-Kanal Insider UA an. Die meisten der einst 24.000 Einwohner hatten Oleschky direkt nach Kriegsbeginn oder nach dem Bruch des Kachowka-Staudamms 2023 verlassen, als große Teile der Stadt überflutet wurden.
Weitere humanitäre Missionen möglich
Auch wenn die Kämpfe nach Ablauf der Waffenruhe am Sonntagabend mit voller Intensität wiederaufgenommen werden dürften, bezeichnen beide Seiten die Evakuierungsmission als Erfolg. Lubinez, der sich gut gelaunt mit seinem russischen Gegenpart, Jana Lantratowa, zeigte, äußerte die Hoffnung, dass die Erfahrungen aus der humanitären Mission in Oleschky »die Grundlage für einen neuen Mechanismus zur Bewältigung komplexer humanitärer Krisen bilden werden, bei dem die Sicherheit der Menschen und das Recht auf Leben im Mittelpunkt stehen.«
Die Erfahrung von Oleschky habe gezeigt, »dass solche Vereinbarungen es ermöglichen, Menschen selbst unter schwierigsten Bedingungen zu helfen. Es ist wichtig, diese Arbeit dort fortzusetzen, wo die Zivilbevölkerung auf Unterstützung wartet«, lobte Lantratowa ihren ukrainischen Kollegen.
Auch aus dem Kreml gab es Lob für die beiden Menschenrechtsbeauftragten. »Zwischen ihnen hat sich ein guter Dialog entwickelt. Das ist wichtig. Sie fangen langsam an, einander zu vertrauen. Das ist gut für die Menschenrechtsarbeit«, so Kreml-Sprecher Dmitri Peskow.
Kritik von Kriegsbefürwortern
Neben viel Lob kommt vor allem aus der Ecke der Kriegsbefürworter in der Ukraine Kritik an Lubinez und dem Waffenstillstand. Auf Facebook wetterte der Publizist und Historiker Wachtang Kipiani gegen Lubinez, vor allem wegen seiner gemeinsamen Auftritte mit Lantratowa. Der Menschenrechtsbeauftragte würde falsche Prioritäten setzen und Russlands Interessen dienen, behauptete Kipiani weiter.
Auch viele Kriegsblogger konnten dem Waffenstillstand nicht viel Positives abgewinnen. Russland würde die Pause nutzen, um seine Stellungen in der Region zu festigen, Soldaten abzulösen und Munition anzuliefern. Frühere Waffenpausen waren an eben jenen (beiderseitigen) Vorwurf gescheitert. Vor allem die »Bild« hatte die Annahme mit nicht belegter Berichterstattung angeheizt. Viele ukrainische Kommentatoren sprangen darauf an. Ihre gemeinsame Schlussfolgerung lautet: »Der Waffenstillstand kommt Russland zugute, nicht der Ukraine – das ist Moskaus Plan.« Belege dafür – wie erwähnt – gibt es nicht.
Wir haben nachgerechnet
Dieser Artikel hat dich nichts gekostet. Uns schon: Recherche, Produktion und Technik. Wir haben bei der Büromiete sowie bei Druck und Vertrieb gespart. Und wir haben auf Gehalt verzichtet. Trotzdem gilt: Ohne dich geht die Rechnung nicht auf. Bis Ende des Jahres brauchen wir 300.000 Euro. Du zahlst, was du kannst, dafür schreiben wir weiter.

https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/.author: Ayse Betul Aytekin
https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/.text:
London police arrest dozens days before Supreme Court hearing on Palestine Action ban
London police arrested dozens of Palestine Action supporters on Saturday, days before the UK Supreme Court hears an appeal against the government's contentious ban on the group.
The Metropolitan Police began detaining people shortly after hundreds of protesters gathered outside the US Embassy for a lunchtime "mass action", AFP reported.
A parallel protest was held outside the US consulate in Edinburgh.
In a mid-afternoon update, the force said 48 people had been arrested and that officers were "continuing to make arrests".
"The majority of arrests have been for expressing support for a proscribed organisation," it said in a post on X.
Nearly 4,000 people have been arrested for allegedly showing support for Palestine Action since the British government proscribed it under anti-terrorism laws in July 2025.
Many of those arrested, including elderly people and Holocaust survivors, have held placards at rallies reading: "I oppose genocide. I support Palestine Action."
Protesters in London on Saturday also carried banners with slogans such as "How is trying to stop a genocide a crime?" and "We are protesters, not terrorists".
The Supreme Court will hold a two-day hearing from Wednesday on an appeal by the group, after the Court of Appeal in June overturned a High Court ruling that the ban was unlawful.

https://www.humanite.fr/-/-/des-couvre-f.text:

Manifestations du 31 octobre : plus de 200 000 manifestants à Paris et 500 000 sur toute la France selon l’Intersyndicale jeune… suivez notre direct
L'essentiel
- 
De très nombreuses mobilisations et manifestations ont lieu ce samedi 31 octobre 2026 partout en France, dans un contexte de forte tension sociale et de présence policière massive.
- 
Manifestation intersyndicale parisienne : un cortège est autorisé et prévu cet après-midi (départ à 14 heures), dont le parcours fixé par la préfecture de police relie la porte de Bagnolet à la porte de Charenton (le recours de l’intersyndicale ayant été rejeté par le Conseil d’Etat). De nombreuses stations de métro sont fermées et un dispositif de sécurité renforcé est déployé.
- 
Autres villes : des actions et manifestations se tiennent dans plusieurs agglomérations.
- 
Mouvements des Gilets jaunes : le collectif recense sur sa carte nationale plusieurs centaines d’actions locales prévues à travers le pays (ronds-points, péages, gares…).
Le Direct
18h27
Fin du direct
18h20
Marseille, Rennes, Bordeaux... le point sur les manifestations dans les grandes villes
À Rennes (Ille-et-Vilaine), la manifestation autorisée entre le Mail François-Miterrand et l’esplanade Charles-de-Gaulle s’est déroulée dans le calme. Le défilé a réuni 25 000 personnes selon les syndicarts, 13 500 personnes, selon la préfecture. À la fin du cortège, un petit groupe s’est formé avant de partir vers la gare de Rennes pour gagner le centre-ville, où la préfecture avait interidt tout rassemblement.
Même cas de figure à Bordeaux, où près de 70000 personnes étaient rassemblées dans le cortège autorisé par la préfecture, selin les chiffres des syndicats. Celle-ci avait ordonné le bouclage de tout le centre-ville et autorisé le survol de la manifestation par des drones de la police.
À Grenoble (Isère), près de 15 000 personnes ont défilé sur le parcours autorisé. La préfecture de l’Isère est l’une des villes où un couvre-feu a été décrété pour ce samedi soir.
À Marseille (Bouches-du-Rhône), 10 000 manifestants ont participé à un rassemblement « non déclaré », a précisé la préfecture. Aucun parcours n’avait été prévu officiellement, mais de nombreux Marseillais sont tout de même descendus dans la rue pour défendre leurs libertés et protester contre la vie chère.
À Toulouse (Haute-Garonne), où toute manifestation était interdite par la préfecture, de nombreuses personnes ont néanmoins manifesté. Les gendarmes mobiles ont tenté de repousser les manifestants en les incitant à remonter les allées Jean Jaurès vers la gare Matabiau, en retrait de l’hypercentre.
De nombreux rassemblements, de plusieurs centaines à plusieurs milliers de personnes, ont également eu lieu dans la plupart des villes moyennes ou petites. Le signe d’une mobilisation d’ampleur sur tout le territoire.
17h40
Des couvre-feux dans plusieurs villes
La préfecture de police de Paris a ordonné vendredi la mise en place d’un couvre-feu dans les secteurs de la place de la République et de Châtelet-Les Halles pour les nuits de samedi à dimanche puis de dimanche à lundi de 23 heures à 6 heures. Après plusieurs jours de couvre-feu partiel à Paris, la mesure avait été levée ces derniers jours. Les mineurs non accompagnés sont aussi concernés par le même dispositif dans d’autres villes, comme Bordeaux, Marseille, ou encore Le Mans.
17h30
L’Intersyndicale jeune annonce près de 500 000 manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris
L’Intersyndicale jeune (Union Étudiante, FAGE, UNEF et Union Syndicale Lycéenne) annonce près d’un demi-million de manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris. L’Union étudiante appelle à bloquer facs et lycées dès mardi 3 novembre. Le ministère de l’Intérieur a lui comptabilisé 320 000 manifestants dans l’ensemble du pays, dont 70 000 à Paris selon la préfecture de police.
16h52
Paris : premières charges policières Porte de Charenton
Le cortège parti de Porte de Bagnolet à 14 heures n’a pas fini d’arriver à Porte de Charenton que la tension monte déjà. La police commence à charger les manifestants, et les premières détonations se font entendre.
Ce parcours a été vivement critiqué par les organisateurs de la mobilisation. D’abord, la volonté de repousser la manifestation loin du centre-ville parisien constitue selon eux une entrave grossière à la liberté de manifester. Ensuite, la configuration du lieu n’est pas propice à la bonne tenue d’un rassemblement si important. Enfin, le peu de transports disponibles ne permet une évacuation des lieux efficaces.
16h45
Sit-in militant près du Sacré-Cœur
Plusieurs rassemblements ou cortèges hors du parcours autorisés sont en cours à Paris. Selon la préfecture de police, 200 à 300 personnes participent à un sit-in près du Sacré-Cœur. La “situation est très calme”, ajoute-t-elle. En revanche, “un cortège sauvage d’environ 150 personnes”, formé rue de Rochechouart dans le 9e arrondissement, est “en cours de dispersion par les Brav-M de la préfecture de police”, ajoute-t-elle, précisant qu’il n’y a “pas de dégradations”.

Aucun parcours n’avait été prévu officiellement, mais de nombreux Marseillais sont tout de même descendus dans la rue pour défendre leurs libertés et protester contre la vie chère.
À Toulouse (Haute-Garonne), où toute manifestation était interdite par la préfecture, de nombreuses personnes ont néanmoins manifesté. Les gendarmes mobiles ont tenté de repousser les manifestants en les incitant à remonter les allées Jean Jaurès vers la gare Matabiau, en retrait de l’hypercentre.
De nombreux rassemblements, de plusieurs centaines à plusieurs milliers de personnes, ont également eu lieu dans la plupart des villes moyennes ou petites. Le signe d’une mobilisation d’ampleur sur tout le territoire.
17h40
Des couvre-feux dans plusieurs villes
La préfecture de police de Paris a ordonné vendredi la mise en place d’un couvre-feu dans les secteurs de la place de la République et de Châtelet-Les Halles pour les nuits de samedi à dimanche puis de dimanche à lundi de 23 heures à 6 heures. Après plusieurs jours de couvre-feu partiel à Paris, la mesure avait été levée ces derniers jours. Les mineurs non accompagnés sont aussi concernés par le même dispositif dans d’autres villes, comme Bordeaux, Marseille, ou encore Le Mans.
17h30
L’Intersyndicale jeune annonce près de 500 000 manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris
L’Intersyndicale jeune (Union Étudiante, FAGE, UNEF et Union Syndicale Lycéenne) annonce près d’un demi-million de manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris. L’Union étudiante appelle à bloquer facs et lycées dès mardi 3 novembre. Le ministère de l’Intérieur a lui comptabilisé 320 000 manifestants dans l’ensemble du pays, dont 70 000 à Paris selon la préfecture de police.
16h52
Paris : premières charges policières Porte de Charenton
Le cortège parti de Porte de Bagnolet à 14 heures n’a pas fini d’arriver à Porte de Charenton que la tension monte déjà. La police commence à charger les manifestants, et les premières détonations se font entendre.
Ce parcours a été vivement critiqué par les organisateurs de la mobilisation. D’abord, la volonté de repousser la manifestation loin du centre-ville parisien constitue selon eux une entrave grossière à la liberté de manifester. Ensuite, la configuration du lieu n’est pas propice à la bonne tenue d’un rassemblement si important. Enfin, le peu de transports disponibles ne permet une évacuation des lieux efficaces.
16h45
Sit-in militant près du Sacré-Cœur
Plusieurs rassemblements ou cortèges hors du parcours autorisés sont en cours à Paris. Selon la préfecture de police, 200 à 300 personnes participent à un sit-in près du Sacré-Cœur. La “situation est très calme”, ajoute-t-elle. En revanche, “un cortège sauvage d’environ 150 personnes”, formé rue de Rochechouart dans le 9e arrondissement, est “en cours de dispersion par les Brav-M de la préfecture de police”, ajoute-t-elle, précisant qu’il n’y a “pas de dégradations”.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.title: Alcolumbre marca votação da PEC da Segurança Pública para terça-feira (3)
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.author: Lucas Pordeus León
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.text:
O presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP), marcou para a próxima terça-feira (3) a votação da Proposta de Emenda à Constituição (PEC) 18 de 2025, conhecida como PEC da Segurança Pública.
De autoria do Executivo, a proposta estabelece penas mais duras e regimes de prisão mais restritos para chefes de facções e milícias e cria um novo pacto federativo entre União, estados e municípios para o enfrentamento ao crime no Brasil.
Além de a medida ser a principal aposta do governo para combater as organizações criminosas no país, o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva prometeu criar um ministério da segurança pública com a promulgação da emenda.
Aprovada na Câmara em março deste ano, a PEC da Segurança Pública teve a análise concluída na Comissão de Constituição e Justiça (CCJ) do Senado no último dia 14 de outubro.
A PEC
Entre outras medidas, a PEC propõe a constitucionalização do Sistema Único de Segurança Pública (SUSP), alterando o Artigo 144 da Carta Magna, que trata da segurança pública.
A proposta inclui que a segurança deve ser exercida “em regime de cooperação federativa” e “por meio da atuação integrada e descentralizada” das diferentes instituições que trabalham com o tema.
“Art. 144-A. Os órgãos de segurança pública articular-se-ão em regime de cooperação federativa, por meio do Sistema Único de Segurança Pública, destinado a assegurar a eficiência da prevenção, da persecução e da execução penal”, define o texto.
Facções e milícias
Além de penas mais duras para chefes de facções e milícias, a PEC restringe ou veda a progressão de regime, do aberto para o semiaberto, por exemplo, para lideranças dessas organizações, que terão que cumprir penas em unidades de segurança máxima.
Também são previstas medidas patrimoniais contra o produto do crime, a responsabilização de pessoas jurídicas envolvidas e a proteção a denunciantes e seus familiares.
Outra novidade da PEC é a possibilidade de criação de polícias municipais de natureza civil, submetidas ao controle externo do Ministério Público, com a atribuição de realizar policiamento ostensivo e comunitário no âmbito das cidades onde atuarão.
A PEC ainda amplia atribuições da Polícia Rodoviária Federal (PRF), prevê a criação de polícias municipais e aumenta a vinculação do orçamento público para segurança pública.
A proposta também prevê a criação do Sistema de Políticas Penais, responsável pelo sistema prisional brasileiro, e autoriza União, estados e municípios a atuarem conjuntamente na legislação sobre segurança pública, organização de polícias, guardas municipais e sistema socioeducativo.
Fundos de financiamento
Segundo a PEC, 50% dos recursos do Fundo Nacional de Segurança Pública (FNSP) e do Fundo Penitenciário Nacional (Funpen) serão repassados pela União para os estados e municípios, excluídas despesas de custeio e investimento da polícia penitenciária nacional do Funpen.
“As regras de financiamento fortalecem o FNSP e o Funpen, criam vinculações e blindagens orçamentárias e garantem repasses obrigatórios. Essas medidas aumentam a previsibilidade financeira, garantindo a perenidade das ações policiais”, escreveu o relator da PEC na CCJ, senador Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE).
A PEC ainda prevê que 10% do superávit financeiro anual do Fundo Social, ligado ao pré-sal, sejam destinados aos fundos da segurança, “reforçando o financiamento contínuo das políticas nacionais de segurança pública e execução penal”.

https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/3.title: Thousands rally in Berlin as Gen Z plans protests in 30 German cities
https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/3.text:
Thousands rally in Berlin as Gen Z plans protests in 30 German cities
Demonstrations sweeping Europe are inspiring young Germans frustrated by rising costs of living amid military spending and conscription.
Berlin, Germany – Thousands of people are gathering in Berlin and more than 30 other German cities as the nation becomes the latest European country to be hit by a wave of student protests sweeping the continent.
Gathering at the Platz des 18 Maerz, on the west side of the capital’s iconic Brandenburg Gate on a sunny but chilly Saturday afternoon, there was support for the young people within a mixed demographic crowd.
Anti-fascist activists smoking hand-rolled cigarettes and wearing keffiyehs waited patiently alongside students dressed in Halloween outfits, smartly dressed grandmothers donning “omas gegen rechts” (grandmothers against the right) badges, and camera crews, ahead of the 2pm (13:00 GMT) rally start.
The protests were organised by a loose alliance called Gen Z Regelt (Gen Z sorts it), and by Saturday morning, nearly 180,000 people across 34 cities had signed up to participate – with the main host cities including Frankfurt, Cologne, Munich and the capital Berlin.
Nearly 12,000 people had signed up to join in the German capital, and people were continuing to stream into the square well into the demonstration to listen to speakers in what was so far a calm afternoon in the capital.
However, at a rally in the western city of Cologne, scuffles broke out between protesters and police, who moved in to contain a march there.
The protest organisers had outlined six key issues that took them to the streets on Saturday, including the rising cost of living, education cuts and military conscription.
‘Political failure’ of government
Students told Al Jazeera that they are both angry and frustrated by ongoing funding cuts, even as the government invests heavily in the military.
Yet they also said they feel a sense of hope after seeing student protests in different parts of Europe in recent weeks.
Veronika Dinter travelled to Berlin on Friday night from Hannover to participate in the protest.
The 23-year-old political science student said that due to high living costs, she had to take on a part-time job to fund her studies.
“I wanted to start studying to develop critical thinking and learn something new, but I didn’t realise how much it would cost to do so. I think this is something a lot of people in my generation are experiencing right now,” she said.
“Funding for education and social services are being cut, while the cost of living keeps rising. Universities are struggling, institutes are closing, teachers are losing their jobs and education facilities are literally falling apart.
“This crisis is the political failure of our government. And instead of solving it, Chancellor Friedrich Merz and his rich friends are funding the military with billions of euros.”
This is a sentiment that Emma Heymann, a 24-year-old student living in Berlin, resonated with.
“Our generation feels very angry at the government because they are making these huge cuts that are affecting our quality of life here. And at the same time, they are spending billions on the military and spending money to fund the genocide in Gaza,” she said.
Protesters should be ‘listened to’
Phil Tziartzianis travelled eight hours from his hometown of Kassel to join his friend Jan Chrominski and other young people at the demonstration.
“It feels important for me to be here among other young people who feel the same way,” he said.
The protesters join a wave of demonstrations that have swept across Europe in recent weeks, including in France, Belgium, Italy, Spain and Serbia.
Kilian Hampel is a senior research fellow at the Future of Work Lab at the University of Konstanz. He says other demonstrations are having an impact on young Germans.
“The frustration itself has been building for years, but this is definitely part of a wave we are seeing across Europe, and young people here are feeling that they can actually take their worries and problems to the streets,” he said. “Many of their concerns, in particular around poor educational infrastructure, are legitimate, and it’s important that they are listened to.”
The Berlin demonstration is expected to last two hours, with another one organised by a different alliance, planned at 5:30pm (16:30 GMT) in a different part of the German capital.
In the past week, political figures have raised concerns about the protests turning violent.
Yet demonstrators say they see the narrative of violence distracting from the issues they want to raise.
“We urge the police to not confront our demonstrations with any kind of violence,” Dinter, the student from Hannover, said.
“We stand in solidarity with all the people around the world who are fighting for an affordable life, for more investment in the education system, and against wars and military buildup.”

https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.title: Artenvielfalt | Deutschland im Prinzip ehrenwert
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.author: Ulrike Henning
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.text:
- Kommentare
- Artenvielfalt
Deutschland im Prinzip ehrenwert
Es geht zu langsam bei dem Erhalt der Artenvielfalt, und es fehlt Geld. Deutschland ist vor allem verbal vorn dabei.
Die globale Biodiversität ist gefährdet. Unter anderem dadurch, dass der Mensch mit seiner Produktions- und Konsumtionsweise immer mehr Lebensräume zerstört. Diesem Problem musste sich auch der UN-Naturschutzgipfel im armenischen Jerewan stellen.
Dass es auch anders geht, zeigt Brasilien: Hier konnte zuletzt die Abholzung des Regenwaldes immerhin gebremst werden – fast 42 Prozent weniger als im Vorjahr wurden zerstört. Zwar ist dieser Erfolg relativ, denn vor der Regierung von Präsident Lula hatte unter Bolsonaro die Abholzung massiv zugenommen. Das Beispiel zeigt, wie wichtig politische Entscheidungen für den Schutz der natürlichen Ressourcen sind.
Die aktuellen Beratungen der UN-Staaten zeigten jedoch, dass manche Länder erst damit anfangen, ihre Natur zu schützen. Auch ist die internationale Finanzierung für Schutzgebiete ist das zweite Jahr in Folge zurückgegangen. Bis 2030 sollen weiterhin mindestens 30 Prozent der Land- und Meeresfläche unter Schutz gestellt werden. Und bis dahin sollten mindestens 200 Milliarden Dollar für den weltweiten Naturschutz mobilisiert werden. Die aktuelle Finanzierungslücke allein beträgt 60 Prozent.
Dass es bei der Umsetzung dieser Ziele hapert, ist unübersehbar. Es geht zu langsam. Sind Deutschlands Beteuerungen in dieser Frage glaubwürdig? Im Prinzip ja, wäre hier die Antwort von Radio Jerewan. Wäre da nicht … die hohe Nitratbelastung im Grundwasser in vielen Regionen. Der massive Einsatz von Pestiziden in der Landwirtschaft. Die Aufweichung der Standards in Schutzgebieten. Die nicht gelungene Reduzierung des Flächenverbrauchs. Aber im Prinzip ist das deutsche Engagement auf globaler Ebene schon ehrenwert.
Ohne dich geht die Rechnung nicht auf
Bei uns muss niemand zahlen, um informiert zu sein. Klingt nach einem schlechten Geschäftsmodell? Ist es auch. Aber uns sind unabhängiger Journalismus und Teilhabe für alle wichtiger als Profit. Journalismus kostet trotzdem Geld: Recherche, Druck und all die Menschen, die ihn machen. Deshalb sind wir auf dich angewiesen. Bis Ende des Jahres brauchen wir 300.000 Euro.
Spende einmalig oder regelmäßig, jeder Betrag zählt. Damit nd bleibt.

https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.title: Polen | Polen im Krisenmodus
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.author: Holger Politt
https://www.nd-aktuell.de/artikel/120357.text:
- Kommentare
- Polen
Polen im Krisenmodus
Der Angriff auf das Verfassungsgericht in Warschau zeigt, wie tief gespalten Polen ist und wie heiß das politische Jahr 2027 wird. Ein Kommentar.
Knapp ein Jahr vor den Parlamentswahlen im Oktober 2027 hat sich die konfrontative Situation zwischen dem Regierungslager unter Ministerpräsident Donald Tusk und dem rechten Oppositionslager mitsamt dem Präsidenten Karol Nawrocki zugespitzt. Der Präsident hat seit Monaten fünf vom Parlament gewählten Verfassungsrichtern die Berufung verweigert, damit nach Auffassung der Regierungsseite die Arbeit des Verfassungsgerichts blockiert, um es weiterhin fest im nationalkonservativen Fahrwasser zu halten. Die gewählten Verfassungsrichter wurden schließlich im Sejm vereidigt, doch verweigerte Bogdan Święczkowski, seit 2024 Vorsitzender des 15-köpfigen Gremiums, die Anerkennung.
Am 30. Oktober 2026 wurde Święczkowski von neugewählten Verfassungsrichtern für abgesetzt erklärt, die Amtsenthebung wurde vom Justizminister Waldemar Żurek ausdrücklich begrüßt. Der Minister sprach von einem notwendigen Schritt, um die Arbeitsfähigkeit des Gremiums wiederherzustellen. Präsident Nawrocki kehrte umgehend von einer geplanten Auslandsreise nach Senegal zurück, sprach von einem Staatsstreich und suchte den Verfassungsgerichtshof auf, ohne aber dort das Gespräch zu suchen. Die in diesen Stunden im Gerichtsgebäude versammelten Richter, so der Präsident kategorisch, seien keine Verfassungsrichter! Anschließend erklärte er, nun mit den Parlamentsparteien reden zu wollen.
Die rechten Oppositionsparteien stellen sich geschlossen hinter den Präsidenten, sehr entschieden trat Jarosław Kacyzński auf, wobei er nicht vom Staatsstreich sprach, sondern von einem Anschlag auf das Verfassungsgericht. Das Verfassungsgericht sei in diesen Zeiten neben der Nationalbank eine der entscheidenden Bastionen, um Polens nationale Souveränität zu verteidigen. Der Präsident, so Kacyzński, müsse nun alle Möglichkeiten nutzen, um dem zerstörerischen Werk der Tusk-Regierung Einhalt zu bieten.
Laut aktuellen Umfragen haben das Regierungslager und das rechte Oppositionslager gleiche Zustimmungswerte, entscheidend werden im kommenden Herbst die Fähigkeiten sein, besser zu mobilisieren als die Gegenseite. Dabei dürften auf der rechten Seite Fragen der nationalen Identität und der nationalen Souveränität eine herausragende Rolle spielen, vieles dort schiebt sich bereits jetzt in einer EU-kritischen Weise zusammen. Kacyzński selbst drohte unlängst ganz offen mit einem EU-Austritt. Tusk hatte darauf geantwortet, dass die Wählerinnen und Wähler jetzt wüssten, worum es im Herbst 2027 gehen werde.
Wir haben nachgerechnet
Dieser Artikel hat dich nichts gekostet. Uns schon: Recherche, Produktion und Technik. Wir haben bei der Büromiete sowie bei Druck und Vertrieb gespart. Und wir haben auf Gehalt verzichtet. Trotzdem gilt: Ohne dich geht die Rechnung nicht auf. Bis Ende des Jahres brauchen wir 300.000 Euro. Du zahlst, was du kannst, dafür schreiben wir weiter.
Keine Paywall, kein Kleingedrucktes, nur ein Ziel: dass nd bleibt.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.title: Ministros realizam diligências em aldeias de MS e ouvem indígenas Guarani Kaiowá sobre onda de violência pós-eleição
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.text:
Uma comitiva interministerial do governo federal desembarcou em Mato Grosso do Sul neste sábado (31) para apurar uma onda de agressões, ameaças e violações de direitos humanos registradas contra comunidades indígenas após o segundo turno das eleições. A missão foi enviada por determinação do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), que pediu que representantes do governo fossem pessoalmente às comunidades.
A comitiva reúne o ministro dos Povos Indígenas (MPI), Eloy Terena, o ministro da Justiça e Segurança Pública (MJSP), Wellington César Lima e Silva, e a ministra dos Direitos Humanos e da Cidadania, Janine Mello. Também participam as deputadas federais Sônia Guajajara (Psol-SP) e Célia Xakriabá (Psol-MG), além de outros parlamentares de Mato Grosso do Sul.
“Essa força-tarefa que foi criada pelo Ministério da Defesa dos Direitos Humanos para a gente apurar a veracidade de todos os fatos e trazer concretude, investigação e penalidade para qualquer tipo de crime que estiver acontecendo no Mato Grosso”, disse Guajajara, ex-ministra dos Povos Indígenas.
O grupo chegou ao estado na noite de sexta-feira (30) e dormiu em Dourados. Na manhã deste sábado, os integrantes da missão saíram da cidade de helicóptero às 8h36 e chegaram, por volta das 9h20, à aldeia Taquaperi, em Coronel Sapucaia, na fronteira com o Paraguai. A reserva, de cerca de 2 mil hectares, abriga mais de 3,3 mil indígenas do povo Guarani Kaiowá e foi demarcada em 1928 pelo antigo Serviço de Proteção aos Índios (SPI), segundo o Instituto Socioambiental (ISA).
“O compromisso do presidente Lula, do nosso governo, é garantir que todos esses atos de violência sejam apurados e investigados, que a gente consiga identificar as pessoas que participaram desses atos e garantir que elas sejam punidas”, afirmou Janine Mello antes do embarque.
O roteiro da comitiva prevê ainda uma entrevista coletiva em Dourados e, à tarde, a partir das 14h30, uma visita à aldeia Sassoró, em Tacuru. Enquanto os ministros dos Povos Indígenas e dos Direitos Humanos visitam as comunidades, o ministro da Justiça tem uma reunião de trabalho com representantes das forças de segurança.
Ameaça de envenenamento
A visita à aldeia Sassoró ocorre depois da divulgação de áudios atribuídos a dois servidores da prefeitura de Tacuru, em que um deles sugere colocar veneno na água consumida pelos indígenas. As gravações circularam nas redes sociais após o resultado do segundo turno. Em um dos trechos, um dos homens diz: “Tem que matar essas pragas na água”.
A prefeitura confirmou que os dois são funcionários municipais. Um deles trabalha como motorista de caminhão-caçamba, na Secretaria de Infraestrutura, e o outro na coleta de resíduos, ligada à área de Meio Ambiente. Ambos foram afastados das funções e respondem a processos administrativos disciplinares. Os nomes não foram divulgados oficialmente.
Segundo o cacique da aldeia Sassoró, Ivan Montiel, cerca de 98% das casas da comunidade têm água encanada, abastecida por poços artesianos, o que aumentou a preocupação dos moradores. De acordo com o Ministério Público Federal (MPF), perícias preliminares não constataram a contaminação dos poços, e os áudios e as ameaças seguem sob investigação da Polícia Federal (PF). O caso também é acompanhado pela Defensoria Pública da União (DPU). Em outra apuração, sobre denúncias de mortes na região, o MPF não encontrou elementos que confirmassem que as vítimas eram indígenas.
‘Violência orquestrada’
Para a deputada Célia Xakriabá, a escalada de hostilidades nos territórios não é um fato isolado, mas uma ação orquestrada de retaliação política contra os povos originários pela mobilização durante a eleição. “Toda essa violência não é pontual, ela não é centralizada, ela não é localizada, ela é orquestrada. Uma violência que encoraja outras pessoas a cometerem os mesmos atos”, afirmou a parlamentar. Célia apontou que o acirramento dos conflitos em Mato Grosso do Sul se intensificou após a aprovação da lei do marco temporal e conta com o estímulo de discursos da bancada ruralista.
Os casos sob investigação da PF e do MPF incluem episódios graves ocorridos nos últimos dias em aldeias Guarani Kaiowá. Na quinta-feira (29), a casa de reza da liderança espiritual Ñandesy Roberta, de 90 anos, foi destruída por um incêndio criminoso na aldeia Jaguapiré, também em Tacuru.
Força-tarefa
A força-tarefa atua em conjunto com a Polícia Rodoviária Federal (PRF) e a Fundação Nacional dos Povos Indígenas (Funai) para garantir a segurança nos territórios e identificar os agressores. A Força Nacional de Segurança Pública, cujo efetivo na região já vinha sendo cobrado por lideranças indígenas diante da escalada de conflitos, também atua nos territórios.
O governo federal orientou as comunidades a recorrerem a canais oficiais de denúncia, como o Disque 100, a plataforma Fala.BR e a Ouvidoria do MPI, e reforçou o combate à desinformação, que amplia a intimidação nas aldeias. Os ministérios reiteraram que a presença do Estado continuará até a apuração total dos crimes e a pacificação da região.

https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-i.title: It’s closer to Beijing than Washington – and residents of this Alaskan outpost are reeling from Trump’s policies
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-i.author: Chris Stein in Unalaska, Alaska
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-i.text:
It was less than 17 hours until the start of Alaska’s lucrative Bering Sea crab season, and Oystein Lone was standing on a dock in the city of Unalaska, preparing to embark in rough conditions.
The problem wasn’t the next day’s forecast of 60mph gusts, which would kick up white-capped swells and make crabbing, already one of the most dangerous jobs in the United States, even more hazardous. Nor was it the question of whether there’d be enough red king, tanner and snow crabs to go around – state regulators had, in fact, announced higher quotas for the season.
What was bothering Lone, as the sun sank lower in the sky that Wednesday evening, was the question of how to make the numbers work when diesel cost more than ever, thanks to the war with Iran.
“This is the most challenging time I’ve seen,” said Lone, who has been fishing since 1989. He had already spent $86,000 to put 12,000 gallons of the fuel in one of his two boats, but the price had climbed higher since then, and if he wanted to fill up again, he expected to spend $100,000.
Located further west than the Hawaiian islands, Unalaska is closer to Beijing, Tokyo and Seoul than Washington DC. Most visitors arrive on flights from Anchorage, which cost at least $1,600 round trip and are prone to cancellation, due to the region’s unpredictable storms and fog.
But Unalaska is by no means a backwater. It has been the country’s most productive seafood port by volume for more than two and a half decades, and when its crab and pollock seasons are open, thousands of deckhands and processors arrive from elsewhere to work tough but well-paying jobs on boats offshore and in seafood plants crowded in the city.
Even here, the impacts of Donald Trump’s efforts to remake the US government in his image can be felt. Since Trump returned to the White House, the library, museum, public radio station and local government have had funding they relied on disrupted or canceled altogether. Longshoremen have been tasked with loading empty containers on to ships to avoid tariffs. And the soaring price for diesel has squeezed not just the seafood industry, but all of the nearly 4,300 residents of the city, who rely on the fuel for electricity.
“This whole town runs on diesel,” said Daneen Looby, a longtime Unalaska resident who sits on the city council and owns the Norwegian Rat Saloon. With distributors upping the fuel surcharges she pays for food and alcohol shipments, Looby is thinking of raising her menu prices. “I didn’t want to, but I kind of have to, otherwise I’m going to become a charity.”
The midterm elections are on Tuesday, and Alaska is set to play a major role in determining if the president’s Democratic foes regain control of Congress. Alaska resoundingly backed Trump in the 2024 election, as did a majority of Unalaska voters, but Democrats believe the president’s plunging public approval ratings together with rising fuel prices have put its two-term Republican senator, Dan Sullivan, at risk of losing re-election to their nominee Mary Peltola, even as scandals rock her campaign.
Candidates only occasionally make the trip to Unalaska, and there are just a handful of campaign signs up around town, but outrage over the direction the country has taken since Trump returned to office is prevalent.
“I feel like we have a rogue government right now, and I don’t feel like the Republicans are doing their job,” Looby said. “I don’t understand why Congress isn’t getting more involved.”
‘In furtherance of the president’s agenda’
The name Unalaska derives from a word in the language of the Unangax̂ people who have lived on the island for thousands of years, and roughly translates to “near the mainland” for its proximity to Alaska’s southwestern peninsula.
Russian fur traders arrived in the middle of the 18th century, and eventually established a colony that came under American control when Washington purchased the Alaska territory in 1867. As the second world war approached, the US military built bases on the large, mountainous island of Unalaska and the smaller Amaknak island next to it, which were connected by a single bridge in the 1970s. In June 1942, Japan staged back-to-back air raids that killed dozens, and there are still concrete pillboxes and bunkers strewn all over town and on the tops of its treeless, windswept hills.
In 2023, the most recent year for which data is available, more than 780m pounds of catch valued at nearly $225m came through its port, Dutch Harbor, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Pollock, a versatile white fish, is the main product, and if you’ve eaten fish sticks, imitation crab or a Filet-O-Fish sandwich at a McDonald’s in Asia or the United States, its ingredients may well have been processed on Unalaska. The different species of crab found in the Bering Sea are also offloaded here, and the travails of that work are documented every year by camera crews who embark from Dutch Harbor to film the reality series Deadliest Catch.
As soon as he took office in 2025, Trump began signing executive orders billed as rooting out waste from the federal government, together with the efforts of Elon Musk’s now-shuttered “department of government efficiency”. Democrats and good governance groups said the campaign undermined important functions of government, and were of dubious legality.
One of Trump’s orders, signed in March 2025, attempted to dismantle a slew of federal agencies, including the Institute of Museum and Library Services (IMLS). The little known office is the source of a yearly grant that Unalaska’s public library receives to buy books, and librarian Karen Kresh expected $6,000 last year, only to be told the money would not be coming.
“It had been stable and been reliable for years and years, and that was sort of a surprise to see that instability come up with that grant,” she said.
The main repository in the United States for cultural and natural history objects from the island chain is the Museum of the Aleutians in Unalaska. When Trump arrived in office, its staff was at work cataloging a large collection of artifacts dating back to the Russians’ first contact with the Unangax̂, funded by more than $347,000 in grant money from the National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH).
At the beginning of April, the museum’s executive director, Virginia Hatfield, received a message saying the grant was being canceled because it “no longer effectuates the agency’s needs and priorities”, and that the funds would be reallocated “in a new direction in furtherance of the president’s agenda”. The cut put the project on hold, and Hatfield was forced to lay off six people.
“It’s very heartbreaking, and it kind of truncated important work,” she said.
Weeks later, Republicans in Congress approved legislation ending funding for public media outlets, which they have long accused of broadcasting news with a liberal bias. The decision had significant implications for Alaska, the largest state in the country which is full of small, remote communities – like Unalaska – unreachable by road, and where cellphone service can be unreliable.
That makes radio the best way to get word out when an emergency strikes, and the same day the Senate began debating whether to cut funding, the island’s public broadcaster KUCB was putting out warning of a potential tsunami. The wave did not arrive, and the station lost half of its budget after Trump signed the bill, said Lauren Adams, the general manager. In the months that followed, KUCB, along with other public media outlets nationwide, experienced a surge in giving from outraged listeners. It was also among more than a dozen Alaska stations to receive temporary funding from the Bureau of Indian Affairs (BIA).
The station now has reserves in the bank, Adams said, but no long-term solution to the question of how to stay open, with annual federal funding gone.
“When you get just this windfall fundraising from around the United States, what’s the sustainability of that?” Adams asked. “Eventually, we’re going to run out of those reserves and things that kept us going.”
Lost opportunities
The second Trump administration hasn’t solely been a disruptive force in Unalaska.
Iliuliuk Family & Health Services is the city’s only clinic, and deals with everything from checkups to emergencies. Soon, they will open a pharmacy that can replace the mail-order drugs most residents rely on, thanks to more than $400,000 from the federal Rural Health Transformation Program.
Created by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, Trump’s main domestic policy legislation, the program was conceived to address concerns from Republicans that cuts to the Medicaid health insurance program for poor and disabled Americans included elsewhere in the legislation would put rural hospitals out of business.
Most of the Medicaid provisions have not taken effect yet, but hospitals nationwide remain concerned that even with the Rural Health Transformation money, they could lose patients vital to keeping their doors open. Christy Fassbender, Iliuliuk’s chief operating officer, said that is unlikely to be an issue in Unalaska.
“We have a very small Medicaid population. We are less than 6% for Medicare and Medicaid, and that is because this is a working town,” Fassbender said.
Nor has the chaos the federal government experienced when Trump first began his term been permanent. In June of this year, the Museum of the Aleutians was notified that the grant from the NEH was back on, though in the time that the funding was canceled, the project director and outreach specialist Hatfield hired found other work, and the professor who had excavated the artifacts providing a glimpse into Unalaska’s past died.
The IMLS eventually restored the funds the library uses to buy books. But recently, Kresh learned that the Federal Communications Commission was considering ending E-Rate, a program that helps the library and Unalaska’s school district provide internet access. If that were to happen, she said, the library would have to look for another way to cover the expense of offering the only free, public wifi in town, which residents and visitors rely on to apply for jobs and stay connected to the world. NEH grants that had been cut nationwide were restored after a lawsuit, and a different suit halted the closure of the IMLS.
Unalaska has felt other consequences of Trump’s presidency, for which there appears to be little recourse.
At Unisea, one of the largest seafood processors in the city, they’re rebuilding their workforce after shifting away from foreign guest workers, visas which have long been hard to get and eventually became too unreliable, director of Alaska operations Ron Kjorsvik said.
The only foreigners still doing the difficult work of processing pollock, crab, black cod and halibut are 15 Ukrainians on a special visa for nationals of the war-ravaged country, but they’ll be leaving soon – none had their visas renewed, Kjorsvik said.
A group of congressional Democrats led by Virginia’s James Walkinshaw had complained to US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) in March about delays processing such applications, and in a reply seen by the Guardian, the agency’s director said USCIS had “many competing priorities and urgent requests for consideration daily”, and could not “prioritize” Ukrainians with U4U visas.
Seafood processing plants on the islands, meanwhile, have their own generators supplying electricity, while the rest of the city runs on a separate, generator-powered grid. Unalaska’s leaders have long contemplated alternatives, including the possibility of tapping geothermal power from a nearby volcano.
Under Joe Biden, the Department of Energy (DOE) established the Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations, and Unalaska’s utility director, Erik Hernandez, said the city was in the process of applying for funds to install five one-megawatt wind turbines and a battery system on a windy parcel of land, which could have replaced most of their diesel generators. But after Trump took office, the DOE stopped communicating about the grant, and in June 2025, the city was informed the money was no longer available.
The DOE did not respond to a request for comment. Earlier this year, the US Government Accountability Office found that the Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations had lost 85% of its staff over the first six month’s of Trump’s second term, and placed a stop work order on all contracts.
The city was as reliant on diesel as ever when the Iran war began and crude oil prices rose in tandem, and the fluctuating rate that Unalaska charges power users to cover the cost of fuel has climbed almost two thirds, from $0.22 per kilowatt hour last year, to as much as $0.36 now, Hernandez said.
The fuel price increase has furthered the stress on a fishing industry that was already not having a great year. Pollock in 2026 have been small and scarce, and storms have been frequent. That has meant less work for Dutch Harbor’s longshoremen who move refrigerated shipping containers filled with seafood onto ships bound for Asia or the US west coast. Shawn Schomer, the International Longshore and Warehouse Union’s shop steward at Matson, one of the major shipping lines serving the port, said he’s recently been getting a new and unusual request from his superiors.
Certain shipping containers that remain for too long in the United States are considered imports, and thus subject to the tariffs Trump has slapped on trading partners globally.
“We got to get these tariff cans out of here. That’s what the management tells us,” when it asks for the containers to be loaded on outgoing vessels, Schomer said.
“It can’t be good business to bring in empties and then have to sort them and ship them back out empty,” he said. A spokesperson for Matson declined to comment.
‘We’re at the bottom’
Lone, 58, has spent his adult life fishing, and expects the high price of diesel to ripple through his industry. Crew members can make six figures in a season, and will see less money, since vessels’ overhead impacts their pay, and the price boats get for their catch could also fall, because processors and shippers will similarly be looking to offset their fuel costs.
“Unfortunately, we’re at the bottom. We take the beating,” Lone said. “Everybody else just passes on their cost to us.”
He wonders if some of the Republicans he had previously trusted to stand up for Alaska’s interests in Washington DC were doing their job.
“I support Sullivan and Begich, but I’m not too sure if they’re doing much for us,” he said, referring to the state’s junior senator and congressman, Nick Begish, respectively. While Lisa Murkowski, the senior senator, has opposed the Iran war and the effort to cut public media funding, Sullivan and Begich supported both, and are facing fierce challenges to their re-elections this year.
As he waited to unload a 135-ton haul of pollock, CJ Peterson, captain of the trawler the Pacific Challenger, said he had been contemplating how much more his business could take. One of Alaska’s native corporations owns his vessel, and Peterson knows the grim economics could some day keep him and his crew on land.
“If the fish price doesn’t match the fuel costs, they’ll shut us down,” Peterson said.
Captain Chris Studeman was not waiting for that to happen. The evening before the noontime start of crab season, he gassed up his boat, the Kevleen K, at one of Unalaska’s marine fuel terminals, and tried not to think about how much more he was paying this year than last.
“Don’t have much choice,” Studeman yelled from the bridge, as his crew prepared the vessel, painted white and green and laden with crab pots, to cast off. “Can’t really change your plan. You just got to go for it.”
And with that, he turned to port and headed north-east, away from Unalaska and into the Bering Sea.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.title: Rede Permaperifa transforma lixões antigos em hortas comunitárias e espaços culturais na Grande SP
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.author: Luís Indriunas
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/10/.text:
De norte a sul da Grande São Paulo, a periferia se reúne em rede para construir, plantar, colher, fazer arte e confraternização, unindo permacultura, agricultura orgânica, formação e resistência. A Rede Permaperifa movimenta, por meio de mutirões, comunidades na região metropolitana da capital e em municípios do litoral paulista.
O Bem Viver esteve na Horta Popular Irati e no espaço Cultura no Beco, na Vila Irati, em Taboão da Serra, município da Grande São Paulo, que fazem parte da rede. Antes um terreno abandonado onde as pessoas despejavam lixo e entulho, o espaço começou a se transformar durante a pandemia. Hoje tem horta, pomar, um galpão onde acontecem aulas, reuniões e festas.
“Eu cheguei por meio da dona Maria. A gente vinha pegar um kit de alimentação. Na pandemia, o pessoal começou a dar. Eles traziam o marmitex. Depois, a pandemia acabou. E a gente começou na horta, fazendo tudo, plantando, colhendo”, conta a aposentada Iraci Jesus Marques, a Dona Iraci, uma das mais ativas integrantes do coletivo.
Há mais de 30 anos em São Paulo e hoje aposentada, dona Iraci aproveita o dia a dia na horta para usar o que aprendeu ainda no interior da Bahia. Assim também acontece com a sua amiga, Maria Oliveira Souza, que veio do Paraná, mais ou menos na mesma época, e também cresceu na agricultura.
“Então, eu vim da lavoura, aí você guarda aquele conhecimento. Como a gente já entendia, a gente foi auxiliando cada um com o que sabia na horta”, conta Dona Maria, que trouxe os netos para as atividades.
“Meu neto faz capoeira, inglês, reforço escolar. Meu outro neto começou na capoeira, depois ele foi para o Kung Fu, futebol, depois ele foi para o Karatê. Hoje ele é faixa-preta em karatê, faz faculdade de educação física. Já faz estágio remunerado lá na academia em Pinheiros. Ele começou aqui, é sementinha daqui”, disse orgulhosa.
A arte também está muito presente em toda a concepção da Permaperifa. Antes da Vila Irati, Taboão da Serra contava, desde 2012, com o coletivo Horta de Gueto, que misturava sound system e agricultura urbana nas praças. Até que, em 2019, surgiu a oportunidade de ocupar o terreno. “Que a gente pudesse ter um pouco mais de acesso à terra e pudesse ampliar as nossas práticas em agricultura, em feiras”, lembra Alex Silva Marinha, o Alex Żüdãö, um dos fundadores da Rede Permaperifa e do Cultura do Beco e morador da Vila Irati.
Para a construção do barracão, surgiu a parceria com o grupo da Capoeira Irmãos Guerreiros, do mestre Marrom. E, assim, a partir da necessidade e da solidariedade, vai se construindo a rede. Os grafiteiros também participam com muros pintados com cenas e pessoas da comunidade.
“Tem espaços que precisam de manutenção de canteiro, tem espaço que precisa de uma construção de algum espaço. Precisa construir um galinheiro, precisa construir uma composteira. E aí entra a bioconstrução, entram diversas técnicas de permacultura e agroecologia, e é uma forma das pessoas se ajudarem, ajudarem a fortalecer esses espaços, que, muitas vezes, esses espaços estão nas periferias e são espaços que não têm esse fortalecimento, então é uma forma das pessoas se autogerirem”, explica a historiadora e integrante da Rede Permaperifa, Shayane Rodrigues Vieira.
Como rede, a Permaperifa se integra entre as comunidades, por meio dos mutirões, que acontecem trimestralmente. O último, o 36º mutirão, aconteceu em setembro, na União Vila Nova, na Zona Leste de São Paulo.
“São pessoas que estão resistindo dentro desses espaços da cidade, buscando principalmente nessa luta a questão da soberania alimentar, de levar uma alimentação saudável. Dentro de espaços que são muitas vezes pequenos, para essas pessoas que não têm esse acesso a esses alimentos, justamente as pessoas que também necessitam e muito desses alimentos. São as pessoas que estão nas quebradas, nas periferias, nos pontos mais esquecidos da cidade”, completa Vieira.
E tem mais…
O Bem Viver traz também o projeto “Campo e Ciência”, uma iniciativa da Universidade Federal de Mato Grosso (UFMT) em parceria com o governo federal. O projeto leva máquinas e infraestrutura a assentamentos da reforma agrária para modernizar o trabalho e dar suporte à agricultura familiar.
A chef Gema Sotto ensina o passo a passo de um tradicional bolo de mandioca (aipim ou macaxeira), ideal para o café da tarde.
Uma visita à Banca do Cordel, no Mercado Municipal de Aracaju (SE), com a participação do poeta Ronaldo Dória Dantas.
E a experiência do Vale das Borboletas, na China, exemplificando a união entre preservação da biodiversidade, turismo ecológico e geração de renda.

https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/uae-c.title: UAE candidate to head UN finishes fourth in first Security Council straw poll
https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/uae-c.author: MEE staff
https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/uae-c.text:
UAE candidate to head UN finishes fourth in first Security Council straw poll
The United Arab Emirates' (UAE) chosen candidate to lead the United Nations came fourth in the informal Security Council Straw poll, as the race to lead the UN heats up.
Friday's vote comes as the Security Council enters the final stretch of selecting who should succeed Antonio Guterres, whose second term ends at the end of the year, on 31 December.
Lana Nusseibeh, a veteran Emirati diplomat who has served the UAE's UN mission for the last decade, was a late entrant nominated by Abu Dhabi on 21 October.
Nusseibeh received seven encourage, six discourage and two "no opinion" votes from the 15-member council.
Due to members of the UN Security Council casting their votes on plain paper ballots rather than colour-coded sheets, diplomats are unable to determine whether any permanent members (P5) - the United States, Britain, France, China, or Russia - cast discouraging votes.

Sign up to get the latest insights and analysis on Israel-Palestine, alongside Turkey Unpacked and other MEE newsletters
Any candidate recommended to the General Assembly must secure at least nine favourable votes and avoid a veto from any P5 power.
The latest straw poll also comes after Middle East Eye revealed that Britain was leaning towards backing Nusseibeh to head the global body.
Human rights organisations and civil society groups have sparked intense debate over Nusseibeh’s entry into the race, heavily criticising UAE foreign policy.
Critics point to her former role as a top official in the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs, where she repeatedly defended Abu Dhabi against UN panel reports implicating the Gulf state in supplying arms and backing the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in Sudan's devastating civil war.
Earlier this week, Sudan’s permanent mission to the UN also told MEE that it had “fundamental questions about Nusseibeh’s independence, impartiality and credibility” as a contender to hold the UN’s top job.
“She has built her career on defending and whitewashing her country’s record of troubling the peace of Sudan by enabling genocide, the enslavement of our women and girls, sexual violence and other atrocities,” the office said.
“The UAE must face accountability, not be rewarded with the top global leadership role of the UN.”
UN experts and international rights groups have accused the RSF of widespread atrocities against civilians.
Non-governmental organisations campaigning against her candidacy have also targeted Abu Dhabi’s domestic human rights record.
Nusseibeh also encounters diplomatic challenges regarding the UN's traditional, informal system of regional rotation, as Costa Rica’s Rebeca Grynspan continues to lead the field with 11 encouraging votes, backed strongly by Latin American and Caribbean states asserting that it is their region's turn to hold the post.
Turkey, meanwhile, officially nominated Feridun Sinirlioglu, a veteran diplomat, former Turkish envoy to the UN and current head of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE). The nomination came just hours after Friday’s vote concluded, bringing the total number of official candidates to seven.

https://www.humanite.fr/-/-/paris-premie.title: Paris : premières charges policières Porte de Charenton
https://www.humanite.fr/-/-/paris-premie.text:
C’est la fin de ce direct, merci de l’avoir suivi avec nous tout au long de la journée. Vous pouvez retrouver dès maintenant toutes nos productions (vidéos et articles) sur le site internet et sur nos réseaux sociaux.
Manifestations du 31 octobre : plus de 200 000 manifestants à Paris et 500 000 sur toute la France selon l’Intersyndicale jeune… suivez notre direct
L'essentiel
- 
De très nombreuses mobilisations et manifestations ont lieu ce samedi 31 octobre 2026 partout en France, dans un contexte de forte tension sociale et de présence policière massive.
- 
Manifestation intersyndicale parisienne : un cortège est autorisé et prévu cet après-midi (départ à 14 heures), dont le parcours fixé par la préfecture de police relie la porte de Bagnolet à la porte de Charenton (le recours de l’intersyndicale ayant été rejeté par le Conseil d’Etat). De nombreuses stations de métro sont fermées et un dispositif de sécurité renforcé est déployé.
- 
Autres villes : des actions et manifestations se tiennent dans plusieurs agglomérations.
- 
Mouvements des Gilets jaunes : le collectif recense sur sa carte nationale plusieurs centaines d’actions locales prévues à travers le pays (ronds-points, péages, gares…).
Le Direct
18h27
Fin du direct
18h20
Marseille, Rennes, Bordeaux... le point sur les manifestations dans les grandes villes
À Rennes (Ille-et-Vilaine), la manifestation autorisée entre le Mail François-Miterrand et l’esplanade Charles-de-Gaulle s’est déroulée dans le calme. Le défilé a réuni 25 000 personnes selon les syndicarts, 13 500 personnes, selon la préfecture. À la fin du cortège, un petit groupe s’est formé avant de partir vers la gare de Rennes pour gagner le centre-ville, où la préfecture avait interidt tout rassemblement.
Même cas de figure à Bordeaux, où près de 70000 personnes étaient rassemblées dans le cortège autorisé par la préfecture, selin les chiffres des syndicats. Celle-ci avait ordonné le bouclage de tout le centre-ville et autorisé le survol de la manifestation par des drones de la police.
À Grenoble (Isère), près de 15 000 personnes ont défilé sur le parcours autorisé. La préfecture de l’Isère est l’une des villes où un couvre-feu a été décrété pour ce samedi soir.
À Marseille (Bouches-du-Rhône), 10 000 manifestants ont participé à un rassemblement « non déclaré », a précisé la préfecture. Aucun parcours n’avait été prévu officiellement, mais de nombreux Marseillais sont tout de même descendus dans la rue pour défendre leurs libertés et protester contre la vie chère.
À Toulouse (Haute-Garonne), où toute manifestation était interdite par la préfecture, de nombreuses personnes ont néanmoins manifesté. Les gendarmes mobiles ont tenté de repousser les manifestants en les incitant à remonter les allées Jean Jaurès vers la gare Matabiau, en retrait de l’hypercentre.
De nombreux rassemblements, de plusieurs centaines à plusieurs milliers de personnes, ont également eu lieu dans la plupart des villes moyennes ou petites. Le signe d’une mobilisation d’ampleur sur tout le territoire.
17h40
Des couvre-feux dans plusieurs villes
La préfecture de police de Paris a ordonné vendredi la mise en place d’un couvre-feu dans les secteurs de la place de la République et de Châtelet-Les Halles pour les nuits de samedi à dimanche puis de dimanche à lundi de 23 heures à 6 heures. Après plusieurs jours de couvre-feu partiel à Paris, la mesure avait été levée ces derniers jours. Les mineurs non accompagnés sont aussi concernés par le même dispositif dans d’autres villes, comme Bordeaux, Marseille, ou encore Le Mans.
17h30
L’Intersyndicale jeune annonce près de 500 000 manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris
L’Intersyndicale jeune (Union Étudiante, FAGE, UNEF et Union Syndicale Lycéenne) annonce près d’un demi-million de manifestants partout en France dont 200 000 à Paris. L’Union étudiante appelle à bloquer facs et lycées dès mardi 3 novembre. Le ministère de l’Intérieur a lui comptabilisé 320 000 manifestants dans l’ensemble du pays, dont 70 000 à Paris selon la préfecture de police.
16h52
Paris : premières charges policières Porte de Charenton
Le cortège parti de Porte de Bagnolet à 14 heures n’a pas fini d’arriver à Porte de Charenton que la tension monte déjà. La police commence à charger les manifestants, et les premières détonations se font entendre.
Ce parcours a été vivement critiqué par les organisateurs de la mobilisation. D’abord, la volonté de repousser la manifestation loin du centre-ville parisien constitue selon eux une entrave grossière à la liberté de manifester. Ensuite, la configuration du lieu n’est pas propice à la bonne tenue d’un rassemblement si important. Enfin, le peu de transports disponibles ne permet une évacuation des lieux efficaces.
16h45
Sit-in militant près du Sacré-Cœur
Plusieurs rassemblements ou cortèges hors du parcours autorisés sont en cours à Paris. Selon la préfecture de police, 200 à 300 personnes participent à un sit-in près du Sacré-Cœur. La “situation est très calme”, ajoute-t-elle. En revanche, “un cortège sauvage d’environ 150 personnes”, formé rue de Rochechouart dans le 9e arrondissement, est “en cours de dispersion par les Brav-M de la préfecture de police”, ajoute-t-elle, précisant qu’il n’y a “pas de dégradations”.
